Operations Brazil, Mexico, Colombia.

nm PRICE IB last 11.65 (print 2026-10-30 23:56 UTC, is_close false), prior close 12.05; October month bar close 11.61 (StockAnalysis also quotes 11.61 close on 2026-10-30). 52w high 18.98, low 11.205; 13w high 16.22, low 11.48. About -39% from the 52w high. Market cap about 4,860.6M x 11.65 = 56.6B USD (share count of 2026-03-01, before the 2026 H1 buyback of 500M USD).

nm LATEST PERIOD Q2 2026 (6-K 2026-08-13) is the latest reported quarter; Q3 2026 results expected 2026-11-12 (per web consensus excerpt, not an issuer source), after as_of: Q2 2026 stands as latest. FY2025 (20-F filed 2026-04-08) is the latest fiscal year.

nm AV DENIED INCOME_STATEMENT 2026-11-01: standard rate limit 25 requests per day reached; not retried; BALANCE_SHEET, CASH_FLOW and EARNINGS_ESTIMATES not called. FMP statements/analyst are denied on this plan (session_capabilities), not called. Second-source statement check therefore done only against the 20-F and the Q2 6-K interim statements (primary documents).

nm DATA GAP SEC companyfacts holds Nu only up to the FY2024 20-F (filed 2025-04-16): no FY2025 and no interim facts. Prefetch pf_ facts end at FY2024, and prefetch/forensic.json roic, altman, beneish are unavailable. FY2025, 2026Q2 and H1 2026 figures were read by me from the 20-F statements (F-7 to F-15) and the 6-K interim statements and entered as nm_ facts (USD thousands x 1000).

nm RECONCILIATION FY2024 pf_ facts vs the 20-F FY2025 comparative column: revenue 11,517,075k, net income 1,972,112k, CFO 2,399,044k, diluted EPS 0.4034, diluted shares 4,888,918k, D&A 77,128k, total assets 49,931,214k, pretax 2,795,198k all match exactly. Equity: pf_equity_fy2024 7,646,289k is equity attributable to the parent (total equity incl. NCI 7,647,076k): label difference only. Cash 9,185,742k matches.

nm RECONCILIATION DIFFERENCES pf_sbc_fy2024 = -372,669k is the XBRL tag ExpenseFromSharebasedPaymentTransactionsWithEmployees (negative sign, 2024 income-statement expense incl. related charges) whereas the cash-flow statement SBC add-back is 272,382k (FY2025 271,845k, 2023 212,551k): the pf sign and amount differ from the cash-flow definition. Use nm_sbc_fy2025 (cash-flow add-back); do not treat the pf FY2024 sign as a benefit. pf_operating_income_fy2024 = 5,630,057k and FY2023 3,576,003k match no IFRS line of Nu (gross profit 5,252,909k, pretax 2,795,198k, total operating expenses 2,457,711k): a bank has no IFRS operating income, so ignore pf operating_income for the valuation (use pretax income / net income). Nu changed its reported total revenue: IFRS total revenue = interest income net of gains/losses on financial instruments + fees; the managerial revenue (Q2 2026 5,875.7M vs IFRS 5,513.2M) adds float-income and other reclassifications of 362.4M.

nm RECONCILIATION FY2025 (20-F, USD k): revenue 15,774,741; gross profit 6,625,002; ECL 4,204,876; pretax 3,868,419; income tax 996,747 (effective 25.8%); net income 2,871,672 (parent 2,868,892); diluted EPS 0.5846; diluted shares 4,907,352k; CFO 3,500,464; capex = PP&E 7,215 + intangibles 333,554 = 340,769; SBC add-back 271,845; D&A 97,968; deposits 41,925,101; total equity 11,321,562 (parent 11,290,948). Cash flow adds back ECL of 4,701,058k (above the P&L ECL 4,204,876k: includes write-off/other items) and CFO is after the growth in credit card receivables (-12.4B) and loans (-10.3B) funded by deposits (+12.9B): for a bank CFO is a balance-sheet-growth number, not free cash flow.

nm RECONCILIATION Q2 2026 (6-K interim FS, USD k): revenue 5,513,208; gross profit 2,346,529; ECL 1,482,213; pretax 1,236,313; income tax 175,224 (effective 14.2%); net income 1,061,089 (parent 1,060,199); diluted EPS 0.2162; diluted shares 4,904,837k. H1 2026: revenue 10,481,175; net income 1,932,520; diluted EPS 0.3936; CFO -1,242,048 (credit growth: cards -8.1B, loans -6.6B, deposits +3.4B); capex 16,226 + 84,248 = 100,474; SBC 216,826; D&A 76,734; buyback 500,393. The press release's managerial P&L net income (1,061.1M) equals the IFRS net income; Q1 2026 net income derived = 871.4M matches the release (871.4). Managerial revenue/gross profit (5,875.7M / 2,441.1M) differ from IFRS (5,513.2M / 2,346.5M) by a stated reclassification bridge (revenue-based taxes 240.9M shown as a cost, funding cost, ECL 208.6M): consensus revenue is probably on the managerial basis.

nm ROIC CHECK prefetch roic is unavailable (needs operating income, debt, cash per year); invalid for a bank anyway: debt and deposits are operating funding, cash 13.6B is mostly regulatory and liquidity funding, so NOPAT/(equity+debt-cash) has no meaning. Use ROE instead (below). Goodwill 409.4M and intangibles 747.1M on 2026-06-30 are small against 13.25B equity (tangible equity about 12.09B).

nm ROE HISTORY net income attributable to parent / average parent equity (computed by me from year-end equity: FY2021 4,441M, FY2022 4,891M, FY2023 6,406M, FY2024 7,646M, FY2025 11,291M, 2026-06-30 13,250M): FY2022 about -7.8% (net loss -365M); FY2023 18.2% (1,031/5,649); FY2024 28.1% (1,972/7,026); FY2025 30.3% (2,869/9,469); H1 2026 annualised about 31.5% (1,932x2 on average equity 12,270M). The company reports annualised quarterly ROE of 33% in Q2 2026, 29% in Q1 2026 and 28% in Q2 2025 (managerial; own definition, release 2026-08-13). Equity grew mainly through retained earnings and FX translation (+667M in FY2025, +493M in H1 2026), not issuance; share premium fell by 500M with the 2026 buyback.

nm TAX Q2 2026 effective tax rate 14.2% (175.2M on pretax 1,236.3M) against 27.6% in Q2 2025 and 25.8% in FY2025; H1 2026 11.8% against 28.7% in H1 2025. Deferred tax assets rose from 2,511M to 3,649M and the cash flow shows deferred taxes of -991M in H1 2026: the 2026 earnings carry a large deferred-tax benefit (the release does not explain its source in the extract read; gather_documents should check note 30). At a 26% rate Q2 2026 net income would be about 915M (EPS about 0.187) instead of 1,061M: do not read the Q2 net income x4 (4.24B) as a run rate; Q2 is also the seasonal high for credit (release: Q2 early delinquencies improve seasonally; NPL 15-90 4.8% vs 5.0% Q1, NPL 90+ 6.9% vs 6.5%).

nm OWN MULTIPLE HISTORY trailing P/E low 15.8 median 39.9 high 71.1 now 15.9 years 2024-2026 sources nm_ib_hist, pf_10k_20260408, nm_6k_q2_fs. Method: IB month-end close / diluted GAAP EPS of the latest 20-F (FY2023 0.2121, FY2024 0.4034, FY2025 0.5846) from the April after year-end, and from August 2026 the trailing four quarters (0.5846 + 0.3936 - 0.2439 = 0.7343); 31 month-ends 2024-04 to 2026-10. The lagged EPS overstates the multiple while earnings grow, so the high and median are inflated. Year-end Dec checks: Dec 2023 close 8.33 / 0.2121 = 39.3; Dec 2024 10.36 / 0.4034 = 25.7; Dec 2025 16.74 / 0.5846 = 28.6; now 11.65 / 0.7343 = 15.9 (11.65 / FY2025 0.5846 = 19.9). Forward P/E on consensus (non-GAAP) EPS: 11.65 / 0.89 = 13.1 (2026), 11.65 / 1.13 = 10.3 (2027). Earlier years have no multiple (net losses FY2019-FY2022; FY2022 EPS negative). Earnings are not at a settled peak but contain the tax benefit above.

nm CONSENSUS (attributed, an expectation, never a fact) StockAnalysis.com page last updated 2026-10-27 (analyst data credited to S&P Global; EPS stated non-GAAP; read with WebFetch on 2026-11-01): FY2026 EPS avg 0.89 (low 0.81, high 0.95), revenue avg 22.80B (low 22.2B, high 24.0B); FY2027 EPS avg 1.13, revenue avg 28.27B (high/low behind a paywall). Implied 2026 H2 EPS = 0.89 - 0.3936 = about 0.50 (Q2 was 0.2162). Revenue consensus is about 22.8B against IFRS FY2025 15.77B and Q2 2026 IFRS 5.51B (x4 = 22.1B): it is on the managerial basis (the page's own +226% growth figure is a page artefact, ignore). Other snippets from a web search (secondary, undated or older): Yahoo Finance 2026 EPS avg 0.85 from 16 analysts (range 0.75-0.93), 2026 revenue avg 22.8B (22.2B-24B), 2027 revenue 28.27B (26.22B-30.27B), 2027 EPS about 1.11; TipRanks 0.86 / 1.11; Seeking Alpha April 2026 snapshot 0.84 / 21.29B; Fintel 1.39 / 13B judged inconsistent. Dispersion of 2026 EPS is narrow (0.81-0.95, about +/-8%); revision direction not available (AV denied; one older April snapshot 0.84 vs 0.89 now suggests upward revisions, weak evidence). Q2 2026 EPS 0.22 against about 0.20 expected (secondary excerpt). Analyst price target (opinion, not evidence): average 18.8, low 12, high 23, median 19, 23 analysts, rating Buy (StockAnalysis, 2026-10-27).

nm TRACK RECORD no numeric guidance exists to track: the Q2 2026 release (nupr2q26_6k) and the 20-F carry no revenue, EPS, NII or margin outlook (grep for outlook/guidance/expected found none; only forward-looking-statement boilerplate). Nu gives qualitative direction only. guidance_track is empty and ticker-check will show no ratio. A softer test (consensus beat) is only a secondary-source remark: Q2 2026 EPS 0.22 vs about 0.20 expected. gather_documents should check the call transcript for any verbal target (for example efficiency ratio, risk-adjusted NIM, ROE aspirations, Mexico break-even) and record it as guidance with its source.

nm BANK STRUCTURE (for the analyst; reported facts from the Q2 2026 release and interim FS) 2026-06-30: customers 138.9M (Brazil about 118M, Mexico 15.8M, Colombia over 5M); total credit portfolio 39.4B (+37% YoY FXN; cards 26.0B, unsecured 10.3B, secured 3.1B); deposits 45.3B (IFRS 45,328M), cost of deposits 88% of interbank rate; Mexico loan-to-deposit 35%; ARPAC 17.1 USD/month; efficiency ratio 19.5% (Q1 17.6%, Q2 2025 21.3%); risk-adjusted NIM 12.4% (Q1 9.5%); NII 3.7B, NIM 22.9%; cost of credit 1.69B managerial (IFRS ECL 1,482M); NPL 15-90 4.8%, NPL 90+ 6.9%; total assets 82.75B, total equity 13.25B, leverage (assets/equity) 6.2x, payables to network 15.5B, borrowings 4.68B. Capital ratios (Basel/Brazilian BIS), liquidity coverage and regulatory capital of Nu Pagamentos/Nu Financeira are not in these documents (gap for gather_documents). Q2 2026 events: Nubank Mexico banking licence received 2026-07-09 and bank launched August 2026; Brazil moving to a full banking licence; Croma launched July 2026.

nm EVENTS after the latest report 2026-10-23 6-K: Chief Technology Officer Eric Young resigned (leaves 2026-11-12; David Velez interim oversight of Global Platforms; permanent search started; company says strategy unchanged). Results of 2026-11-12 (Q3 2026) fall after as_of 2026-11-01.
